page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance within the ecs.d1 family. It is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining feature of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture.

Given the reliance on HDD storage rather than SSDs, this instance is optimized for sequential read and write operations and high-capacity data retention rather than random IOPS-heavy workloads. It represents a cost-efficient option for massive data storage, large-scale log processing, distributed file systems, and data warehousing where storage volume is prioritized over ultra-low latency disk access.
